meta.title: Mightling — coding helper wey dey run for di machine wey dey your table
meta.description: Coding helper wey dey run for one NVIDIA DGX Spark and no dey send anything comot. For test of 100 real programming wahala e solve 68, for about 48 tokens (word pieces) per second. No cloud, no account, no bill per use, no tracking.
meta.og_title: Mightling — coding helper wey dey run for di machine wey dey your table. E solve 68 out of 100 test problems.
meta.og_description: E solve 68 out of 100 real programming problems from SWE-bench Verified, for one DGX Spark wey no need network, for about 48 tokens per second. No cloud, no account, no bill per use, no tracking.
install.h101:
Coding helper wey dey run for your own machine.
E solve about 69 out of every 100 test problems.
install.p02: 68 out of 100 real programming problems from SWE-bench Verified, solved without internet for one DGX Spark, for about 48 tokens per second. (Token na small piece of word; di machine dey write about 48 of dem every second.) Mightling na coding agent, chat assistant and desktop app, and all of am dey run for your own GB10. Dem no dey send anything go cloud. No account, no bill for each use, no tracking. How we measure am
install.span04: # e go download di model once (~20 GB), then e go start am
install.p06: Dis one dey work for di NVIDIA DGX Spark and for every oda GB10 machine. Di script dey check each download against di release checksums, and e dey show you each sudo command before e run am. You fit read di script first.
install.p08: Your oda computers dey borrow di GB10 model for your house or office network. For Mac or another Linux machine, di same command dey install ling, di part wey you dey type inside. E dey find di GB10 by itself.
install.p09: From 1.7.2 e dey put di desktop app inside Applications for Mac too, ready to open. Add --no-app if you no want am.
install.p12: Type dis one inside PowerShell. E no need administrator rights (from 1.7.2 dat one include di desktop app too). Then Windows go ask you one time to set up one closed place where di agent go run commands. Di installer no get signature yet, so Smart App Control must dey off. Read di script.

new.h201: New for 1.7: di desktop app for Mac, Linux and Windows
new.p02: Di desktop app for 1.7.0 put both ways to use Mightling inside one window: Ask, where you dey put questions, and Work, where di agent dey edit your code. Work get box to type tasks inside (you fit attach files, skills and commands), pane to look di changes before you keep or undo dem, separate working copies of your code (worktrees), terminal tabs, and file tree beside di conversation. For your oda computers, di app dey talk to your GB10, wey e dey find for your network.
new.p04: From 1.7.2, di install command dey put Mightling inside Applications next to ling, and you go open am like any oda app. E dey run for Apple silicon and Intel, with macOS 12 or later. ling update dey update am.
new.p06: For di GB10, di file mightling_1.7.0_arm64.deb dey install di app, im menu entry and di ling-app command, with di sandbox profile wey e need. (Sandbox na closed room to run commands, so dem no fit touch di rest of di machine.)
new.p07: Then open am from di application menu, or type ling app. More.
new.p09: From 1.7.2, di PowerShell line dey install di app too, for you alone and without administrator rights, with entry inside di Start menu. Settings → Apps dey remove am, and ling update dey update am. Smart App Control must dey off.
new.p11: Di release page get di Mac disk image too (Mightling-<version>-arm64-preview.dmg, or x64 for Intel) and di Windows installer (Mightling-Setup-<version>-x64.exe, or arm64). Dem na unsigned previews, so when you download dem for browser, your system go stop dem di first time. Before you open one, check am against di release signed SHA256SUMS file.
new.li12: macOS 15 and later: drag Mightling go Applications and open am one time. Then go System Settings › Privacy & Security and press Open Anyway. For macOS 14 and earlier, Control-click di app and choose Open.
new.li13: Windows: SmartScreen › More info › Run anyway. Smart App Control must dey off.
new.p14: Also inside 1.7.0: Night Shift fit try one task many times and keep di best try (/night add --best-of N). One machine fit run plenty Signal bridges. And computer wey see two GB10s for one network fit choose between dem without forgetting di one wey e don know already. Release notes and downloads.
benchmark.h201: SWE-bench Verified, wey we measure for one DGX Spark
benchmark.p02: SWE-bench Verified na set of 500 real problems wey dem take from open-source programs. For each one, di agent must change di code so di tests go pass. On 2026-10-08 we give 100 of dem to Mightling 1.5.1, wey dey use di Qwen3.8-27B model, for one DGX Spark without internet. E get one try for each, for im default mode, and e solve 68 out of di 100. If we scale am up to all 500, we estimate about 69%, give or take few points (di 95% range na 63.9 to 73.4%). We measure dis one ourselves, for our own machine, for sample of di problems. Na no be entry for di official leaderboard.

benchmark.p29: Read dis table as way to see who dey near, no be ranking. For di same 100 problems, Mightling solve as many as Qwen3-Coder-480B and GLM-4.6, models wey big pass am many times. But every row dey use different agent program and different hardware, and di leaderboard rows use di official test images for x86 computers, while ours run for community images for arm64. Another mode still dey, wey dem call refine. First session go study di problem and e no go change anything, then fresh session go do di work. E solve one more problem than di default (69 against 68, and each mode solve some problems wey di oda one miss), and e take about 2.2 times as long for each problem. So e dey off unless you ask for am with ling --refine.
benchmark.p31: 100 problems na one-fifth of Verified, so di figure for all 500 na estimate. Na so we take do am. Take di results of all 175 public Verified submissions, problem by problem. Give every problem difficulty and every system ability, with one-parameter item-response (Rasch) model. Mightling ability na di one wey go solve 68 for dis 100 problems, and about 69% na wetin dat ability go score for all 500. Plain regression on di published scores agree within one point. We also check di method on oda people: for every public submission we use only im score for dis 100 problems to predict im score for all 500. Di error na 2.4 points (RMSE), and di range above na 1.96 times dat one for each side. You fit reproduce every number inside di table with scripts/swe_bench_compare.py, from di public per-problem data for SWE-bench/experiments.
benchmark.p32: We spread di 100 problems across di programs inside Verified for di same proportions as di full set. We draw dem from di problems wey their test setup dey work and check out for arm64 (di correct fix go pass, and to do nothing go fail). Published systems score 1.0 to 1.5 points lower for dis 100 than for all 500, so di sample no easy. Still, e no be leaderboard entry, because di SWE-bench team dey grade those ones for their own machines.

try.p02: Or leave work for tonight with /night add <task>. Mightling go go through di list while you dey sleep, each task for its own git branch, and for morning you go look di branches.
proof.h201: Your code dey stay for your table, and you fit check say e dey so
proof.p02: Cloud coding agent dey send your source code go computers wey belong to somebody else. Mightling no dey send am anywhere. Di model dey run for your GB10, and nothing inside Mightling dey phone home: no usage counts, no measurements, no sign-in, even "anonymous" crash reports no dey. So you fit use am for code wey dem no allow you upload, like client work, protected data or product wey never release.
proof.p03: One command dey run real Mightling session under strace, tool wey dey watch every call wey program make, then e go list each network connection wey di session open:
proof.p04: Everything stay for 127.0.0.1, wey be di machine dey talk to itself. Not even one DNS lookup (DNS lookup na to ask di internet for di address of one name).
proof.p06: Type /airgapped on. Every command wey di agent run go then get empty network from di Linux kernel. Dat one no be polite request to di model. Network just no dey to reach. For di same time, Full Access, wey fit go round di sandbox, dem go refuse am.
proof.p08: Only wetin you or di agent ask for: web search (through private SearXNG wey dey run for your own machine, though di search itself still dey go out to di web), fetch of web page, read-only request to Google account wey you connect, or check for updates. With /airgapped on, none of dem go happen.
why.p03: Di model, your code, your questions and im answers stay for di machine wey dem dey.
why.li05: Egress audit wey you fit run again
why.p14: Na speeds for one task at a time for one GB10. Di model dey use trick wey dem call speculative decoding: small helper dey guess many words ahead and di big model dey check all di guesses at once. "Work for code" dem measure am over real agent sessions. Writing code, JSON and prose, dem measure each for dat kind output. Di last line na how much text e fit hold for mind at once, 262K tokens, wey be few hundred pages. Run four agents at once if you like. No quota, no "abeg wait".
why.li16: No tuning: we choose di model, di memory size, di low-level code and di speculative decoding for di GB10.
why.li17: E no suppose freeze your machine: e dey check di machine before e load di model, and e dey watch memory while e dey load.
why.li18: Your oda computers go find am for your network.
features.p03: E dey read your project, run commands and tests, edit code, and ask you first before anything wey get risk.
features.p05: Type /night add <task> before you sleep. By morning each task don finish for its own git branch. Nothing go merge or push unless you do am.
features.p07: Search dey pass through private SearXNG for your own machine, so no search account and no key to get. Di questions still dey go out to di web to get answer.
features.p09: List of where things dem define and who dey use dem across your project, so di agent fit look code up and no go search am by guessing.
features.h310: 🧩 Di skills wey you don get already
features.p11: Skills wey you write for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw or Hermes dey work here as dem be.
features.p13: Questions with web search, image search and to talk instead of to type, and your agent sessions too, from dis machine or from phone wey you don pair with am. All of am dey use di same model for your machine.
features.p15: Ask and Work for one window, for di GB10, Mac, Linux or Windows. Di agent sessions dey ask your approval, and pane dey to review changes, separate working copies, and undo. New for 1.7.
features.p17: Read-only, through sign-in wey stay for your machine. /airgapped on dey switch am off completely.

machines.h201: E dey run for every GB10
machines.p02: Dem share di same chip, di same 128 GB memory wey processor and graphics share, and DGX OS 7, so one installer cover all of dem. We dey develop and test Mightling every day for di ASUS Ascent GX10. Our automated tests cover di oda ones, but we no dey run dem by hand.
paper.h302: Architecting Local, Air-Gap-Capable Desktop Clients for Agentic AI Pair Programmers: Protocol Compatibility, Process Isolation, and Host Memory Safety
paper.p04: We describe di design of Mightling Desktop, desktop program wey be open source. We give formal list of wetin e fit do and wetin e no fit do, and we measure am. E dey speak di same app-server protocol as di desktop client from di upstream vendor, e keep di same defaults as Codex, e dey run di model for di user own hardware, and e dey keep every command inside di sandbox for di workstation when di user type /airgapped on.
faq.p03: Yes, to run di model. Your oda computers na clients wey dey borrow am: Linux (Arm or x86) and macOS with di same install command, and Windows (Arm or x86, preview) with di PowerShell line.
faq.summary04: I install Puffin. Na di same program?
faq.p05: Yes. Dem rename Puffin to Mightling for 1.5. Run puffin update once, then run puffin one last time. E go move your sessions, settings and links come, and after dat di command na ling.
faq.p07: Nothing for di program or for di model. Mightling na open source under di AGPL, and di model weights free to use. You go pay for di machine and di electricity wey e dey use.
faq.summary08: Wetin I need apart from di machine?
faq.p09: Di operating system wey e come with (DGX OS 7, or Ubuntu 24.04 where NVIDIA dey offer am), Docker with di NVIDIA Container Toolkit, Python 3 and Git. For plain Ubuntu, ling-admin host check go tell you wetin miss.
faq.summary10: Anything dey ever go out to di internet?
faq.p11: Only wetin you or di agent ask for, like web search (through SearXNG wey dey run for your own machine) and di downloads for first use. With /airgapped on, all of dem dey off.
faq.p13: Qwen3.8-27B, for NVIDIA 4-bit format wey dem call NVFP4, wey SGLang dey serve with small guessing helper wey dem call DFlash2 drafter. We choose and tune all of am for di GB10. Di weights take about 20 GB, and while e dey run, about 38 GB of di machine memory go still free.
cta.h201: Keep your code for your table
cta.p02: If you think say code suppose stay for di table where dem write am, star di repository for GitHub. Na so oda GB10 owners dey find Mightling.
footer.p01: Mightling by Dreamference. Dreamference dey build private AI wey dey run for your own hardware.
footer.p02: Open source under di GNU AGPL v3. NVIDIA, GB10, DGX and DGX Spark na trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation; oda names na trademarks of dia owners. Mightling and Dreamference no connect with dem.
footer.p03: Dis site no dey ask any oda site for anything: no trackers, no counting of visitors, no fonts from anywhere else.
mock.s3: Explain how the repo take stand

mock.agent: String wey be only spaces pass di check, because di check run before dem remove di spaces. I don dey strip di spaces first now, inside src/auth/signup.py, and I add test so say e go stay fixed.
new.c1_h3: Di ling-serve engine, di ScaleSearch drafter, and Forgejo for each node
new.c1_p: Di optional ling-serve dey run Qwen3.8-27B for di GB10 with 262K-token memory. Every node get im own private Forgejo (place to keep git repositories), and di Telegram Mini App dey work directly on your repositories.
new.c2_h3: Host sockets closed, local file index, and LoRA adapters
new.c2_p: Inside di command sandbox, di Docker, containerd, D-Bus and systemd sockets dey closed (socket na door wey program fit use give orders to di system). ling-docs now dey read scanned pages and office documents too, and di server fit serve signed LoRA adapters (small add-ons wey dey change wetin model good for).
new.c3_h3: Di desktop app for macOS, Linux and Windows, and Night Shift best-of-N
new.c3_p: Ask and Work share one desktop window, with review pane, worktrees and terminal tabs. /night add --best-of N dey run task N times and e dey keep di best try.
surfaces.r3_h3: JetBrains, VS Code, and your phone
surfaces.r3_p: You fit connect JetBrains or VS Code through stdio MCP (ling-admin mcp). You fit also send messages go your GB10 from Signal (to yourself, inside Note to Self), from Telegram (with di Mini App to work on repositories), and from Matrix over Tailscale. Every phone link dey off until you turn am on. Signal get end-to-end encryption, and Matrix dey run for server of your own. Telegram messages dey pass through Telegram servers without encryption, so use am only for things wey you no go mind to share dat way.
resources.c2_h3: How to start, and di documentation
resources.c2_p: How to make GB10 safe to load, how to start di model server, how to pair Mac, Linux and Windows computers with am, and how to run di egress audit.
